reason: I already have an inverter and battery at home, so if I buy a washer at all I will buy a normal semi-automatic and run it off the inverter during cuts. Paying almost double for a second battery inside the machine makes no sense when we are saving every rupee for the wedding.
objection: I have never heard of this brand, and a battery inside a washing machine near water worries me. If it fails after three years, who will fix it and what will a new battery cost?
would_change_my_mind: If the dealer showed me my inverter cannot run a washer and the price came down near a normal semi-automatic, around 13,000-14,000, from a brand people in my village already use.
